quranTranslation.text: The alms are only for the poor and the needy, and those who collect them, and those whose hearts are to be reconciled, and to free the captives and the debtors, and for the cause of Allah, and (for) the wayfarer; a duty imposed by Allah. Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: Zekat pripada siromasima (فُقَرَاء) i nevoljnicima (مَسَاكِين) – obje riječi, kao dvije skupine.
explanation.en: Zakat is for the poor (فُقَرَاء) and the needy (مَسَاكِين) — both words, as two groups.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! Ye are the poor in your relation to Allah. And Allah! He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

explanation.bs: „O ljudi, vi ste siromasi kojima je Allah potreban, a Allah je Neovisni, Hvaljeni“ – potreba svakog stvorenja.
explanation.en: “O mankind! Ye are the poor in your relation to Allah. And Allah! He is the Absolute” — the need of every creature.

quranTranslation.text: (Alms are) for the poor who are straitened for the cause of Allah, who cannot travel in the land (for trade). The unthinking man accounteth them wealthy because of their restraint. Thou shalt know them by their mark: They do not beg of men with importunity. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, lo! Allah knoweth it.

explanation.bs: Siromasi koji ne dosađuju ljudima traženjem; zbog njihove suzdržanosti neupućeni ih smatraju bogatima.
explanation.en: The poor who do not ask people persistently; because of their restraint the ignorant think them self-sufficient.

quranTranslation.text: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.

explanation.bs: Lađa je pripadala nekim siromasima (مَسَاكِين) – imaju lađu, a ipak su مِسْكِين: dokaz onih koji kažu da je فَقِير u većoj nevolji.
explanation.en: The ship belonged to poor people (مَسَاكِين) — they own a ship yet are مِسْكِين: the proof of those who hold the faqīr worse off.

quranTranslation.text: Or some poor wretch in misery,

explanation.bs: „ili nevoljnika koji u prašini leži“ (ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ) – dokaz onih koji kažu da je مِسْكِين u većoj nevolji.
explanation.en: “Or some poor wretch in misery” (ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ) — the proof of those who hold the miskīn worse off.

quranTranslation.text: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.

explanation.bs: Onaj ko ne podstiče da se nahrani siromah – مِسْكِين kao onaj kome treba hrana.
explanation.en: Who does not encourage the feeding of the poor — the مِسْكِين as one who must be fed.

quranTranslation.text: Say, (O Muhammad, to mankind): If ye love Allah, follow me; Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Ako volite Allaha, slijedite mene, pa će vas Allah voljeti“ – ljubav vjernika prema Allahu i Allahova ljubav prema njemu, kako Njemu dolikuje.
explanation.en: “If ye love Allah, follow me; Allah will love you” — the believer's love for Allah, and Allah's love for him as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love. And whatsoever ye spend, Allah is Aware thereof.

explanation.bs: „…sve dok ne potrošite od onoga što volite“ – ljubav prema imetku.
explanation.en: “…until ye spend of that which ye love” — love of wealth.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! thou (O Muhammad) guidest not whom thou lovest, but Allah guideth whom He will. And He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.

explanation.bs: „Ti ne upućuješ na pravi put onoga koga voliš“ – ljubav prema bližnjem.
explanation.en: “Thou (O Muhammad) guidest not whom thou lovest” — love for one dear to you.

quranTranslation.text: Many of the people of the Scripture long to make you disbelievers after your belief, through envy on their own account, after the truth hath become manifest unto them. Forgive and be indulgent (toward them) until Allah give command. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Mnogi od sljedbenika Knjige žele da vas, nakon što ste vjerovali, vrate u nevjernike“ – želja da drugi zastrane.
explanation.en: “Many of the people of the Scripture long to make you disbelievers after your belief” — a wish that others go astray.

quranTranslation.text: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.

explanation.bs: „Možda će oni koji ne vjeruju poželjeti da su bili muslimani“ – kasna želja.
explanation.en: “It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims” — a wish that comes too late.

quranTranslation.text: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.

explanation.bs: „Oni bi voljeli da ti popustiš, pa da onda i oni popuste“ – želja za kompromisom u vjeri.
explanation.en: “Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise” — a wish for compromise in faith.

quranTranslation.text: And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them, and He ordained between you love and mercy. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect.

explanation.bs: „…i stavio je među vas naklonost i milost“ – مَوَدَّة među supružnicima kao Allahov znak.
explanation.en: “…and He ordained between you love and mercy” — مَوَدَّة between spouses as a sign of Allah.

quranTranslation.text: It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with whom ye are at enmity. Allah is Mighty, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Možda Allah uspostavi naklonost između vas i onih među njima s kojima ste neprijatelji“ – naklonost koja može zamijeniti neprijateljstvo.
explanation.en: “It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with whom ye are at enmity” — affection that can replace enmity.

quranTranslation.text: Thou wilt find the most vehement of mankind in hostility to those who believe (to be) the Jews and the idolaters. And thou wilt find the nearest of them in affection to those who believe (to be) those who say: Lo! We are Christians. That is because there are among them priests and monks, and because they are not proud.

explanation.bs: „…i naći ćeš da su vjernicima naklonošću najbliži…“ – naklonost jednog naroda prema drugom.
explanation.en: “…And thou wilt find the nearest of them in affection to those who believe…” — one people's affection for another.

quranTranslation.text: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.

explanation.bs: „Ako biste nabrajali Allahovu blagodat, ne biste je mogli izbrojati“ – jednina kao rod: sva dobra stanja.
explanation.en: “If ye would count the bounty (نِعْمَة) of Allah ye cannot reckon it” — the singular as a genus: every good state.

quranTranslation.text: Forbidden unto you (for food) are carrion and blood and swineflesh, and that which hath been dedicated unto any other than Allah, and the strangled, and the dead through beating, and the dead through falling from a height, and that which hath been killed by (the goring of) horns, and the devoured of wild beasts, saving that which ye make lawful (by the death-stroke), and that which hath been immolated unto idols. And (forbidden is it) that ye swear by the divining arrows. This is an abomination. This day are those who disbelieve in despair of (ever harming) your religion; so fear them not, fear Me! This day have I perfected your religion for you and completed My favour unto you, and have chosen for you as religion al-Islam. Whoso is forced by hunger, not by will, to sin: (for him) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Danas sam vam usavršio vašu vjeru i upotpunio Svoju blagodat prema vama“ – blagodat kao dobro stanje koje Allah upotpunjuje; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “This day have I perfected your religion for you and completed My favour unto you” — favour as the good state Allah brings to completion; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And covet not the thing in which Allah hath made some of you excel others. Unto men a fortune from that which they have earned, and unto women a fortune from that which they have earned. (Envy not one another) but ask Allah of His bounty. Lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „I molite Allaha da vam da od Svoje dobrote“ – dar koji On nije dužan dati; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But ask Allah of His bounty” — a gift He is not bound to give; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful.

explanation.bs: „…razidite se po zemlji i tražite od Allahove dobrote“ – mufesiri to tumače kao traženje opskrbe zaradom i trgovinom.
explanation.en: “…then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty” — the mufassirun explain this as seeking provision, by earning and trade.

quranTranslation.text: Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice. It is better than what they hoard.

explanation.bs: „Reci: Zbog Allahove dobrote i zbog Njegove milosti – eto, zbog toga neka se raduju!“ – dobrota kao dar od Allaha preko dužnog; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice” — bounty as a gift from Allah beyond what is due; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).

explanation.bs: „… To je Nama lahko sabiranje“ – o proživljenju; lahko, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “That is a gathering easy [yasīr] for Us (to make)” — of the resurrection; easy, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

explanation.bs: „… taj će biti obračunat lahkim obračunom“ – lahkoća za čovjeka.
explanation.en: “He truly will receive an easy [yasīr] reckoning” — ease for a human being.

quranTranslation.text: If the enemy had entered from all sides and they had been exhorted to treachery, they would have committed it, and would have hesitated thereupon but little.

explanation.bs: „… i ne bi se u tome zadržali osim malo“ – ar-Rāġib: drugo značenje, ‚malo‘.
explanation.en: “And would have hesitated thereupon but little” — ar-Rāġib: the second sense, ‘little’.

quranTranslation.text: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.

explanation.bs: „… Gospodar tvoj kaže: ‚To je Meni lagano, a i tebe sam prije stvorio, a nisi bio ništa‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Thy Lord saith: It is easy [hayyin] for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.

explanation.bs: „… i smatrali ste to sitnicom, a to je kod Allaha veliko“ – lagano u očima ljudi, teško kod Allaha.
explanation.en: “Ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.” — light in people's eyes, weighty with Allah.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and it is easier for Him. His is the Sublime Similitude in the heavens and the earth. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

explanation.bs: „On je Taj Koji stvaranje započinje, pa ga ponavlja, i to Mu je još lakše …“ – poredbeni oblik iste riječi (ahwan); ar-Rāġib ga navodi uz nju; kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “He it is Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and it is easier for Him” — the comparative of the same word (ahwan); ar-Rāġib cites it beside it; as befits Him.
